top_signals.title: MSCI Freezes Turkey Indexes as Fund Turmoil Fuels Scrutiny
top_signals.summary: MSCI Inc. is stepping up scrutiny of Turkey’s equity market following a crisis in the country’s fund industry, freezing some index changes and warning that its emerging-market status could eventually be at risk.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ship-Fuel Crunch to Persist Despite More Oil, Vitol Says
top_signals.summary: Accelerating crude exports through the Strait of Hormuz aren’t translating into higher production of a dirty shipping fuel, according to a top Vitol Group executive, tightening supplies and sending prices soaring.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Indonesia Stocks Sink Most in 28 Years on MSCI Downgrade Warning
top_signals.summary: Indonesian stocks suffered their worst rout in nearly three decades after MSCI Inc. warned the country’s emerging-market status was in jeopardy, raising the prospect of its removal from global indexes and stoking fears of foreign capital flight.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
